changes: The complete isolated test dependency set and the JavaScript runtime requirement are documented so the registered prerequisite and review controls can be tested together.
Retained behavioral tests cover comment round trips, literal text handling, invalid-import rejection and save and download handlers; browser rendering and permissions remain outside this evidence.
Public review wording and the explanation of the nominal depth boundary are clarified to match the returned applicability flag.
Cited formula coefficients are checked against calculation behavior, and worked pressures are independently anchored to hand calculations.
Canonical line endings and registered regeneration inputs make report reproduction portable and subject to the documentation drift check.
The original corrosion-pressure calculation is demonstrated on a published pipe example, with the intact design-pressure cap distinguished from the module's uncapped factored pressure.
Pressure demand and the implemented relative-depth boundary are drawn with a calculated depth sensitivity so that pressure shortfalls and the limit of the calculation are visible.
Existing numerical comparisons are distinguished from field qualification, and the additional data required for an operating decision are identified.
